The original native control is disabled and 52 pt high, so this finding is limited to rendered appearance. A post-capture whole-control histogram records dominant #EDF0F3 and a common glyph color #A1A8AF; it is diagnostic support, not a preapproved pixel test. Source cause and independent attribution remain unconfirmed.
